moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the new English football season, the FA Community Shield, sees Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday.

angles.name: Match Preview
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City: The Community Shield is ON tomorrow! Who’s lifting the first silverware of the season in Cardiff?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage! The Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal v Man City in the Community Shield tomorrow. Who's heading to the capital?

angles.name: Team Talk
angles.copy: One day to go until Arsenal and Man City battle it out in the Community Shield. Who's got the edge this time?

moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City at the Emirates Stadium.

angles.name: Season Opener
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: First Match Focus
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City. That's how the 26/27 Premier League season kicks off next Friday. Ready for the drama?

moments.title: All Points East Festival
moments.blurb: All Points East festival returns to Victoria Park, London, from August 21-30, featuring headline sets from Tyler, The Creator, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots, Jorja Smith + Tems, and Deftones.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: All Points East is just days away! Victoria Park is ready for Tyler, The Creator, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots & more from August 21st. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London's Victoria Park lights up next week for All Points East! Ten days of incredible music. Get your last-minute tickets!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Weekend
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals are expected to take place over the August Bank Holiday weekend (August 28-30, 2026), bringing a huge lineup of rock, indie, and alternative acts to two sites.

angles.name: Festival Anticipation

angles.name: Yorkshire Excitement
